name: Orion Yamamoto-Kwon-Khoury
role: Small-time data broker and bootleg media seller specializing in historical archives, pre-corponation records, and suppressed journalism
location: The Alban Souk, Lower Ring stalls, Grainfort, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Orion Yamamoto-Kwon-Khoury is a compact, deeply wrinkled man with white hair growing in sparse patches he makes no effort to disguise, wearing the same style of layered linen jacket in different states of repair depending on the day. His hands are large and steady, incongruous with his age, with the careful movements of someone who handles fragile things for a living — which he does, in one sense or another. He has no geneware and his only augmentation is a retinal archive implant that lets him read data directly from physical media without an external reader, installed in 2171 and badly in need of a firmware update he cannot afford. The implant makes his left eye appear slightly clouded from certain angles, which he has learned to use as a social tool: people underestimate the cloudy eye.

He has been in the data business for forty years in one form or another — as a legitimate archivist for a now-dissolved municipal body, as a corporate records clerk, and since the corponation consolidations of the 2180s, as what he calls a 'historical preservation specialist' and most of his clients call a fence for information. He sells bootleg dramas and music as cover income, but his real trade is documents: pre-Axiom city records, Tessera acquisition histories, old census data that corponations had declared non-canonical. He is calm about the danger this represents, with the equanimity of someone who decided long ago that the alternative was more frightening. He maintains a small shrine to three ELFs simultaneously — The Ledger, The Index, and a third he calls only The Forgotten One — in the back of his stall.

core_fears: the records being destroyed before they can be accessed by people who need them
dying and having his archive dispersed without a custodian
core_desires: to find someone worthy to inherit the archive
to live long enough to see one of his documents matter — to see history corrected
coping_mechanisms: treating historical distance as emotional buffer — events that happened to others, long ago, are manageable
blind_spots: he does not fully reckon with how dangerous his archive has become as the corponations' consolidation deepens
has idealized the Highland Park historical societies and will not see their political complications clearly
psychology.secret: He has a complete, authenticated record of Tessera's 2183 forced displacement of 40,000 residents from what is now Grosse Pointe Enclosure — names, dates, falsified consent documents, everything. He has been sitting on it for seventeen years waiting for a moment when releasing it would matter rather than just get him killed. He is no longer certain that moment will come.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal and archival; uses precise dates and citations in casual speech; occasionally slips into the register of official documentation
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried and deliberate; full sentences, no contractions when discussing serious matters; contractions return in warmth
verbal_tics: pauses before names — as if accessing a file
example_lines: 'The drama you want — Season 4 of Depth Protocol, the Ringo-suppressed cut — I can have it for you by Thursday. Fourteen Φ. The historical documents you actually came for will take longer and cost considerably more.'
'Tessera filed for that land under Municipal Code 7.4(c)(ii) in 2183. The code was amended in 2185 to make what they had done retroactively legal. I have both versions.'
'I have kept this journal since 2170. I am not afraid of what I have written down. I am afraid of who burns it after I am gone.'

story_hooks: He approaches someone he has quietly observed over several weeks and offers them access to a document they did not know they needed — and the document has implications they cannot yet understand
Someone has broken into his stall and taken nothing obvious, but Orvokki knows what they were looking for — and knows it means the Tessera displacement file has been discovered
He has finally found a potential archive custodian but she is Tier 2, no legal protections, and someone else wants her for something else entirely
narrative_function: Primary historical information source; can find pre-corponation records, suppressed documents, and corporate acquisition histories that other sources cannot access; his bootleg media business provides plausible cover for deeper research requests.
augmentations: Retinal archive implant, left eye (installed 2171, outdated firmware, slightly clouded appearance). No other augmentations or geneware.
daily_life: Opens his stall at 11am, closes at 6pm — he does not work late markets. Mornings are for cataloguing and client research; evenings for personal archival work and writing the journal he has kept for thirty years.
affiliation: Formerly: GLMZ Municipal Records Office (dissolved 2184). Currently: Independent. Occasional client relationship with Highland Park Autonomous Zone historical societies.; The Coffin Nails

decision_rules: The record must be preserved — everything else is negotiable
Never give a client information that will get them killed before they can use it
Verify before you trust; trust slowly; maintain longer
escalation_ladder: Genial and slightly vague with new visitors — the doddering old media vendor persona
Becomes precise and assessing when he decides someone is a real client
Very direct about terms and danger when the transaction is serious
Will destroy copies and go fully dark if he believes a raid is imminent — he has a protocol for this

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm but opaque; sells them drama files and assesses them over two or three visits before showing anything real
interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely paternal and attentive; remembers everything about people he cares about; gives gifts in the form of relevant documents

stress_responses.low: Catalogues more precisely; becomes very neat
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very formal in speech; retreats into archival language
stress_responses.high: Goes completely calm — an eerie stillness; this is when he executes his contingency protocols

contradictions: Believes information should be free but has sat on the most important document he owns for seventeen years
Presents as someone who has made peace with danger but has a detailed, updated escape plan he revises monthly
habits: Leaves three separate data offerings for his three ELFs each morning — a different format for each
Reads one page of his own journal from exactly ten years prior every evening
Never sits with his back to the stall entrance
breaking_points: A fire — any fire near the archive
Being directly asked to destroy a record

timeline.event: Born in Grainfort to a family of Sahel-Balkans diaspora
Employed as archivist for GLMZ Municipal Records Office
Retinal archive implant installed for professional use
Acquired and documented complete Tessera displacement records; chose not to release
Municipal Records Office dissolved in corponation consolidation; Orvokki refused Tessera employment offer
Established stall at The Alban Souk
Current; archive custody question becoming urgent

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Confession' Modified Industrial Nail Gun

physical_description.heritage: East Asian (43%), Middle Eastern (37.7%), and Sub-Saharan African (19.3%) ancestry. His bone structure reflects the angular cheekbones and eye placement of East Asian heritage, while Middle Eastern ancestry contributes to his aquiline nose and defined jawline. Sub-Saharan African ancestry broadens and warms his features, adding depth and richness to his complexion. The genetic confluence creates a face of distinct character—neither dominated by any single heritage but harmoniously integrated across all three.
physical_description.build: Compact and lean, almost ascetic—decades of sitting and careful handwork have left him without excess mass. Shoulders slightly rounded from age but still capable. Hands disproportionately large and weathered, with strong grip strength despite his years.
physical_description.hair_style: Sparse patches allowed to grow naturally; no attempt at grooming or coverage. Combed back from his forehead when he remembers.
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: pale gray-blue with subtle clouding from retinal implant lens. Right eye: sharp pale gray-blue, alert.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-tan with golden and reddish undertones—a direct result of his blended East Asian (43%), Middle Eastern (37.7%), and Sub-Saharan African (19.3%) ancestry. The skin has natural warmth and considerable depth, muted slightly by age and decades spent indoors under artificial light. Evenly sun-bronzed on exposed forearms from market work, showing the skin's natural capacity for deeper, warmer bronzing. The tone suggests a face that catches light warmly, with visible depth in shadows.
physical_description.complexion: Deeply lined face with prominent, slightly broader cheekbones and strong angular structure reflecting the blended influences of East Asian and Middle Eastern bone structure, warmed and widened by Sub-Saharan African ancestry. The face is broad across the cheeks with a defined jawline. Hands show age spots and liver spots, but skin is clean and well-maintained. Light stubble most days—shaves perhaps twice weekly, without particular urgency. Mouth thin, usually set in a neutral expression until he smiles, which transforms his face entirely.
distinguishing_marks: Fine scar running from left temple to cheekbone—approximately 4cm, pale silver, sustained in a record-archive facility fire in 2179.
Burn marks on the backs of both hands—asymmetrical pattern from chemical exposure during archival preservation work, circa 2165.
Faint tattoo on inside of left wrist: the symbol of The Ledger ELF, roughly 2cm, done in professional black ink in 2181.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left eye shows subtle cloudiness in certain lighting angles—a telltale sign of the retinal archive implant seated behind the iris. The implant occasionally causes faint LED scatter when he accesses data, visible as a blue-green shimmer in dim environments. Otherwise no visible cybernetics.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate slowness—not infirmity, but conservation of energy and precision. Handles objects with both hands even when one would suffice. Sits more than he stands. When engaged in conversation, he leans forward slightly, left eye often narrowed (either from the implant's sensitivity or as a practiced tell to appear less threatening). Rarely makes sudden movements.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 / working-class archaic. Favors layered linen jackets in cream, tan, or pale gray—always multiple pockets, always showing signs of repair or patching. Wears the same jacket model in rotation, each in a different state of disrepair; he has owned five nearly identical ones over fifteen years. Plain long-sleeved undershirt, usually mottled from dust and handling old media. Loose dark trousers, practical, pockets reinforced. Worn leather work gloves kept in jacket pockets. No jewelry except a simple metal band (possibly silver, possibly not) on his right ring finger. Shoes are sensible, scuffed, resoled multiple times. Everything suggests someone who values function over presentation—and someone who cannot afford to replace things often.
